instagram.caption:
Minecraft's Creeper is a pig that went wrong.

In 2009 Notch was modeling a pig and mixed up the height and length. Instead of a long, low animal he got a tall body standing upright on four tiny legs.

He found it creepy, painted it green and made it explode. It is now the face of the game.

How many of your houses did a Creeper blow up?
